info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_E-Trading Workbench Management API
info.description: The E-Trading Workbench Management API enables users to update various aspects of their e-trading workbench configurations seamlessly. Organizations can utilize this endpoint to modify settings related to investment management, thereby enhancing trading efficiency and user experience. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, trading firms, and investment managers looking to customize their trading environments. This API streamlines the management of trading functionalities, ensuring that users have real-time access to an optimized trading workspace.
